reason: The cited evidence (E1–E3) demonstrates L10 ordering and coercivity enhancement in (FeCoNiMnCu)Pt with 50 at.% Pt, but the hypothesis proposes only ~5 at.% Pt in FeCoNi without Mn or Cu. The evidence does not show that such a low Pt content can induce L10 ordering, nor that the resulting phase would retain the required configurational entropy, leaving key premises unsupported.
premises: RTA of FeCoNi-based films can induce L10 ordering when Pt is present
L10 ordering enhances magnetocrystalline anisotropy via reduced symmetry and Pt spin–orbit coupling
Increased magnetocrystalline anisotropy leads to higher coercivity
A near-equiatomic FeCoNi alloy with ~5 at.% Pt can retain high configurational entropy (≥1.0R) after ordering
